GINZZZU_CAMERA_FRAMES.Settings.Appearanc: GM Sets One Appearance for Everyone

In shared mode everyone uses the GM settings. When personal customization is enabled, players choose the appearance of their own cameras from permitted values, and each camera is displayed the same way to every participant.
GINZZZU_CAMERA_FRAMES.Settings.CameraFra: The shared frame thickness for circular cameras. Style, color, and finish are selected separately. Choose No Frame to hide the frame completely.
The shared frame color. Material colors and a full basic spectrum are available independently from style, thickness, and finish.
The shared visual treatment of the frame: a flat color, shaded dimensional surface, or colored glow. This does not change the glare over the camera image.
The shared frame line pattern for circular cameras. It works independently from thickness, color, and finish.
GINZZZU_CAMERA_FRAMES.Settings.CameraGla: The shared glare intensity over the circular camera image. Glare is configured independently from the frame.
GINZZZU_CAMERA_FRAMES.Settings.CameraInn: The shared shading depth around the inner edge of a circular camera. Stronger levels extend visibly farther into the image.
GINZZZU_CAMERA_FRAMES.Settings.CameraMas: Black-and-white mask for Foundry's standard cameras: white keeps the video visible, black makes it transparent. The GM selects one mask file for the World.
GINZZZU_CAMERA_FRAMES.Settings.CameraSha: The shared camera shape. It is used by everyone or becomes the default when the GM allows personal customization.
GINZZZU_CAMERA_FRAMES.Settings.UserCamer: Your personal frame thickness for your camera. When customization is allowed, this camera appearance is displayed consistently to every participant.
Your personal frame color for your camera. When customization is allowed, this camera appearance is displayed consistently to every participant.
Your personal flat, dimensional, or glowing frame finish for your camera. This camera appearance is displayed to every participant.
Your personal frame line pattern for your camera. This camera appearance is displayed to every participant.
Your personal glare over your camera image. The selected effect is displayed to every participant.
Your personal inner shadow for your camera. Stronger levels extend farther into the image, and the selected effect is displayed to every participant.
Your personal camera shape. When customization is allowed, the selected shape is displayed consistently to every participant.
